title: senecio compactus
intro: Senecio compactus, commonly known as Dwarf Fleabane, is a low-growing, perennial herb native to Australia. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, which have been found to possess various therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Senecio compactus include its potential to alleviate skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its ability to act as a natural insect repellent. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
